CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wt_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.wt_user_roles
    where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wt_is_coach()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.wt_user_roles
    where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'coach'
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.wt_is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.wt_user_roles
    where user_id = auth.uid() and role in ('coach', 'admin')
  );
$function$
